guided tour = a visit to a place with someone who explains it
excursion = a short trip for pleasure, often in a group
day trip = a journey there and back on the same day
city break = a short holiday in a city, often a weekend
cruise = a holiday on a large ship that visits several ports
harbour = a place on the coast where boats stay safely
coast = the land next to the sea
seaside = a place by the sea where people go on holiday
beach = sand or stones next to the sea
sunbathe = to sit or lie in the sun to get a tan
sunscreen = cream that protects your skin from the sun
tent = a shelter made of cloth that you sleep in outdoors
sleeping bag = a warm bag you sleep in when you camp
hike = a long walk in the countryside or mountains
trail = a path for walkers in the hills or forest
signpost = a sign that shows the way and the distance
map = a drawing of an area that shows roads and places
ask the way = to ask someone how to get to a place
go straight on = to continue in the same direction
turn left = to change direction to the left
